To increase the autonomy of space missions across the full Solar System, and thus offloading the overloaded ground stations, ESA is developing a concept for Solar System Internet. Currently, spacecraft navigating in the Solar System rely on explicit, pre-planned setup of point-to-point communication links for their navigation. Such approach, does not scale well with the large number of missions planned in the future. Such a system would combine existing (i.e., GNSS) or planned (i.e., Moonlight, MARCONI) systems and would complement this with dedicated SSI nodes. These nodes would provide ranging capabilities through point-to-point links (as broadcast links are not scalable over long distances).
